title: Find Common Factors
text: Find the greatest common factor (GCF) of $$63$$ and $$105$$, or use prime factorization.\n$$63$$ $$=$$ $$3$$ * $$3$$ * $$7$$\n$$105$$ $$=$$ $$3$$ * $$5$$ * $$7$$

title: Simplify
text: Cancel out the common factors of $$3$$ and $$7$$.\nThe remaining factors are $$3$$ in the numerator and $$5$$ in the denominator.
